summary: Register and configure a public Notion OAuth connection to integrate workspace content and APIs for external users.

verdict.label: Medium
verdict.approval_required: Notion security review is required only if listing on the Marketplace; standard OAuth can be used without listing.

prerequisites.text: A Notion account with access to the Developer portal to create a public connection.

steps.title: Create a public connection
steps.detail: Log into the Developer portal and register a new public connection to obtain the client ID and client secret.

steps.title: Configure redirect URIs
steps.detail: Specify the required redirect URI(s) under the OAuth configuration section in the Developer portal.

steps.title: Build the OAuth authorization URL
steps.detail: Construct the authorization request pointing users to Notion's OAuth endpoint, supplying the client ID and redirect URI.

steps.title: Implement the token exchange endpoint
steps.detail: Write code to handle the authorization code callback, exchanging it via POST to the token endpoint using HTTP Basic Auth for client credentials.

steps.title: Handle rate limiting and errors
steps.detail: Incorporate logic to respect rate limit headers (HTTP 429 / 529), manage retry-after values, and gracefully catch user cancellations or missing redirect URIs.

approval.summary: Required only if you wish to list your public connection on the Notion Marketplace.

blockers.problem: User cancels the OAuth flow, resulting in an access_denied error redirected to your redirect URI.
blockers.fix: Build connection error handling to catch user cancellation gracefully.

blockers.problem: Missing redirect_uri in token exchange when multiple URIs are configured.
blockers.fix: Ensure the exact matching redirect_uri is supplied in the POST request to the token endpoint.
Read the Retry-After header and use exponential backoff with jitter.

agent_can: Write application code for the OAuth redirect and token exchange flow
Set up environment variable configurations for client credentials
Implement rate-limit queues and error handling routines
you_must: Log into the Developer portal to create the connection and retrieve credentials
Authorize apps via the live OAuth prompt and complete page picker selections
uncertain: Granular scope definitions that trigger specific reviews
Privacy policy rules, required video submissions, business entity requirements, minimum user thresholds, and fees for marketplace listing
Published wait times for marketplace security reviews
origin: Generated live by the research agent (gemini-3.5-flash-lite) - not reviewed by a person

composio.note: Composio provides a managed OAuth app, so you only need your own for custom branding, scopes or quota.
